text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: Cross-zone egress latency spike (eu-west2->eu-west3). Alert: pd-INC-8472. p95 and p99 breaching SLOs; streaming stalls increasing. https://alerts.internal/r/INC-8472
Priya Patel: I'm oncall, acked. Joining triage now. Who's got the dashboard?
metrics-bot: Dashboard snapshot: p95 = 480ms (baseline 130ms), p99 = 1.8s (baseline 220ms), streaming stall rate = 31% of live sessions in eu-west region. Rolling increase started ~ 1814506200.
Kevin Ramirez: Seeing huge retransmit counts from nat-gateway-eu2 (RX errors increasing). TCP handshake RTTs jump to 700-1500ms.
Alex Chen: Also seeing DNS tail times spike to 600-1200ms for resolver-resolve-1 in eu-west2. A number of TLS handshake retries logged on egress-proxy-2.
Maria Gonzales: Customer impact: support picked up 17 tickets so far complaining about stalls and incomplete streams. Escalating for customer comms.
Priya Patel: Ok first cut: (1) check routing/NAT for packet loss (2) failover to secondary NAT gw as fallback (3) mitigate DNS by switching to alternate resolver pool (4) reduce application socket timeouts to avoid long stalls. Will coordinate.
Kevin Ramirez: I'm prepping autoscale for nat-fallback. Can launch proxy-nat-ephemeral instances in ~2m.
Alex Chen: Dumping brief logs: ```
[egress-proxy-2] 2026-03-14T10:03:12Z TLS handshake failed: timeout after 5s, client_ip=10.12.3.45
[nat-gw-eu2] 2026-03-14T10:04:02Z tx_errors=412 rx_errors=398 retransmits=10231
[resolver-1] 2026-03-14T10:05:01Z lookup_time=1024ms service=upstream-dns-1
```
Priya Patel: Running runbook 'cross-zone-egress-failover' now. Kevin, please spin up nat-fallback and attach to egress-target-group. Alex, prepare to update /etc/resolv.conf on edge nodes to 10.2.1.5 and 10.2.1.6.
metrics-bot: Noted. Executing synthetic checks as we switch.
Kevin Ramirez: nat-fallback instances launched and healthy. Adding to ALB target group. ETA to traffic shift ~ 40s.
Priya Patel: Shifting 30% of traffic to fallback NAT via weighted routing to reduce blast radius.
metrics-bot: After partial shift: p95 down to 260ms, p99 down to 980ms, streaming stalls down to 14% (was 31%).
Jamie Lee: Joining handoff — tagged in. Good mitigation so far. We should keep failover in place until network team confirms underlying link stability.
Nate Kim: Network team here — seeing microburst packet-loss on inter-AZ fabric between azb and azc in eu-west2. Provider reported transient fiber flap earlier at ~10:00 UTC that coincides. BGP neighbor flaps contributed to route re-convergence.
Alex Chen: That explains the retransmits + TLS retries. Middlebox in path may be dropping SYN/ACKs and causing rehandshakes.
Priya Patel: Next step: change resolver pool for edge nodes, and bypass egress proxy for streaming traffic to reduce extra TLS hops. Kevin, can you add ip rule to route streaming subnets directly to nat-fallback?
Kevin Ramirez: Adding policy route now: ```ip rule add from 10.20.0.0/16 table 200 priority 200``` and update iptables to mark streaming conn. Pushing in 10s.
metrics-bot: Partial direct-route applied. p99 for streaming flows improved to ~420ms but non-streaming egress still fluctuating.
Maria Gonzales: Customer comms: posting interim status to affected customers, linking to incident page. Tickets assigned: INC-8472-01..-17.
Priya Patel: Also reducing socket keepalive from 10s -> 3s for streaming clients to accelerate reconnects and clear stalled streams faster. Deploying config change to streaming-config service: ```STREAM_KEEPALIVE=3s```
Alex Chen: Quick DNS mitigation: edge resolvers switched to alternate pool 10.2.10.5/6. Confirming resolution times now ~30-60ms.
Nate Kim: Provider reports stabilized BGP and link; we're seeing packet loss fall back to baseline. We'll keep monitoring for 30m.
metrics-bot: Post-mitigation snapshot: p95 = 140ms, p99 = 260ms, streaming stalls = 3.5%. All within SLOs for eu-west.
Priya Patel: Great. I'll start incident handoff — I'm going offline in 18m. Jamie, please accept command. Notes: NAT failover left active, direct-route for streaming persistent for 1h, DNS alternate pool in place, keepalive reduced, postmortem + customer impact assigned to Maria + Nate.
Jamie Lee: Taking over. I'll keep the runbook active and monitor for 2 hours. If any re-regressions, escalate to network oncall and open provider ticket with traceroutes and pcap. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8472 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maria Gonzales: Filing postmortem doc and assigning action items. Will include timeline, affected customers, and required provider follow-up. Owners: Priya (triage & runbook), Nate (network follow-up), Maria (customer comms).
Priya Patel: Thanks team. Closing CLI session and handing off screenshots to Jamie. Will add final notes to postmortem draft.
Jamie Lee: Copy. Marking channel for follow-up. Keep alerts noisy for 2 hours then lower to watch level.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8472: resolved flag not set — currently in monitoring state.
Maria Gonzales: I'll send out the customer email template after we validate logs for the last hour.
Priya Patel: Signing off. :wave:
